_note: Threat levels (Logan, 2026-11-08 and 11-19; tasks/Threat levels in the Hermes vault). Level 0 is the plain mission; each level adds its effect and keeps every one below. Names and Operator lines are Claude's drafts (2026-11-19) for Logan to vet. Numbers are in balance.json "threat"; {name} in the text is filled from there.

levels.name: Standard
levels.operator: Standard op. Get in, hit the target, get out.

levels.name: Contested
levels.operator: They've put veterans on the line. Expect them to soak more than usual.

levels.name: Hot Zone
levels.effect: They're expecting you: elites open every fight with an extra move.
levels.operator: Word got out. Their elites will be set up and waiting when you engage.

levels.name: Counteroffensive
levels.effect: Captured bays: enemies may be waiting at a repair bay. Win the fight to use it.
levels.operator: They're pushing into our rear. Some repair bays may already be in their hands.

levels.name: Lockdown
levels.effect: On alert: the boss fights its phase 2 playbook from the start.
levels.operator: The commander knows you're coming. No warm-up this time.

levels.name: Last Stand
levels.effect: Supply lines cut: fights pay {scraps_less_pct}% fewer scraps.
levels.operator: Our convoys are getting hit. You'll be working with whatever you can salvage.
